run_fuzz_build: run the fuzz build pipeline for boost mysql with a source dir, branch, and server host
review_fuzz_build: review the fuzz_build function that orchestrates boost mysql fuzzing with corpus setup and b2 build
summarize_fuzz_build: summarize the fuzz_build function which installs boost, generates seed corpus, sets up db, and runs fuzzing targets
test_fuzz_build: test the fuzz_build function by providing a source directory, boost branch, and database server host
refactor_fuzz_build: refactor the fuzz_build function to support configurable corpus paths and parallel build options
